inputs.text: Funny how quickly this becomes an ICE hero story: a baby stops breathing in a crowded TSA line at JFK, and DHS releases footage framing an agent as the savior. The agency controls the video and the narrative, so I’d be wary of treating this polished account as the whole story. Turning a frightening airport emergency into good publicity for enforcement looks less like transparency than image management.
